quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Eating a bowl of cereal for breakfast"?
quests.hint: Think about the very first meal you eat after waking up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat breakfast in the morning, after the sun comes up.
quests.funFact: Cereal was actually invented to be a quick, healthy way to start the morning!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Putting on cozy pajamas before bed"?
quests.hint: Think about the soft, comfy clothes you wear to sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We change into pajamas at night, right before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Some pajamas are made with extra soft fabric to help you feel cozy and relaxed!

quests.instruction: "The sun shining high in the sky" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the giant, bright star that lights up our sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! The sun is high in the sky like this during the day.
quests.funFact: The sun is so big that over a million Earths could fit inside it!

quests.instruction: "Seeing the moon glowing softly in the sky" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the round, glowing light we see after the sun goes down.
quests.explanation: Yes! The moon glows in the sky at night, after the sun has set.
quests.funFact: The moon doesn't make its own light — it reflects light from the sun!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Playing on the swings at the playground"?
quests.hint: Think about when children usually go outside to play.
quests.explanation: Yes! Kids play outside on swings and slides while it's light out.
quests.funFact: Swinging on a swing is a fun way to feel the wind on your face!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Brushing our teeth right before bed". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about the last thing we do in the bathroom before climbing into bed.
quests.explanation: Yes! We brush our teeth at night, just before we go to sleep.
quests.funFact: Nighttime brushing is extra important, since it protects your teeth all night long!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Riding the school bus to class". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when children go to school to learn.
quests.explanation: Yes! School buses pick up children in the morning to start the school day.
quests.funFact: The very first school buses were actually pulled by horses!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Stars twinkling high above"?
quests.hint: Think about the tiny, sparkling lights we see in a dark sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Stars twinkle in the sky once it gets dark.
quests.funFact: The light from some stars took thousands of years to reach your eyes!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds"?
quests.hint: Think about what color the sky is when the sun is out.
quests.explanation: Yes! The sky looks blue with clouds when the sun is shining.
quests.funFact: The sky looks blue because sunlight bounces off tiny bits of air!

quests.instruction: "Listening to a bedtime story" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the story someone reads to help you feel sleepy.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bedtime stories are read at night, right before sleep.
quests.funFact: Listening to a story before bed can help your brain relax and dream!

quests.instruction: "Having lunch in the school cafeteria" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the meal you eat in the middle of your school day.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lunchtime happens in the middle of the day, between morning and afternoon classes.
quests.funFact: Many schools ring a bell to let everyone know it's time for lunch!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Tucking a teddy bear snugly into bed"?
quests.hint: Think about when you get your favorite stuffed animal ready for sleep too.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tuck our toys into bed at night, alongside ourselves.
quests.funFact: Many children have one favorite stuffed animal they sleep with every single night!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Painting a picture in art class". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when children are usually at school taking classes.
quests.explanation: Yes! Art class happens during the school day.
quests.funFact: Painting helps children practice using their imagination and their hands together!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Turning on a soft glowing lamp beside the bed". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about the small light some children keep on while they sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! This little glowing lamp, sometimes called a night light, softens the dark room.
quests.funFact: A soft glowing lamp like this can help make a dark bedroom feel cozy and safe!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Splashing in a pool on a hot afternoon"?
quests.hint: Think about when the word 'afternoon' happens.
quests.explanation: Yes! Afternoon happens in the middle of the day, while the sun is still up.
quests.funFact: Swimming is a great way to cool off when the sun is shining bright!

quests.instruction: "An owl hooting softly from a tree" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the bird known for staying awake while most animals sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! Owls are nocturnal, which means they are awake and hooting at night.
quests.funFact: An owl can turn its head almost all the way around to look behind it!

quests.instruction: "A butterfly landing on a flower" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when most butterflies are awake and fluttering around.
quests.explanation: Yes! Butterflies are active and fluttering around flowers during the day.
quests.funFact: Butterflies actually taste flowers using their feet!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Crickets chirping in the grass"?
quests.hint: Think about the small insect known for its chirping song after dark.
quests.explanation: Yes! Crickets chirp loudly at night, once the sun has gone down.
quests.funFact: Crickets actually chirp by rubbing their wings together, not with their mouths!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Watering the plants in the garden"?
quests.hint: Think about when people usually work outside in the garden.
quests.explanation: Yes! Gardening happens outside while it's light enough to see the plants.
quests.funFact: Plants use sunlight, water, and air to make their own food!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Saying goodnight to our family". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about the last thing you say before heading off to bed.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say goodnight right before going to sleep.
quests.funFact: Saying goodnight is a warm way to end the day with the people you love!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Riding a bike down the sidewalk". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when it's easiest to see where you're riding.
quests.explanation: Yes! It's easiest and safest to ride a bike outside while it's light out.
quests.funFact: Riding a bike is a fun way to get exercise and explore your neighborhood!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Fireflies glowing softly in the yard"?
quests.hint: Think about the small bugs that light up like tiny lanterns after dark.
quests.explanation: Yes! Fireflies glow and light up the yard at night.
quests.funFact: Fireflies make their glowing light using a special chemical inside their bodies!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Putting on sunglasses to block the bright light"?
quests.hint: Think about when the sun is bright enough to need eye protection.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wear sunglasses to protect our eyes from bright sunlight.
quests.funFact: Sunglasses were first made to help people see better in bright snow!

quests.instruction: "Pulling up a warm, soft blanket" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about what covers you to keep you warm while you sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pull up a blanket at night to stay warm and cozy while sleeping.
quests.funFact: Some blankets are extra heavy on purpose, to help people feel calm and relaxed!

quests.instruction: "Flying a kite in the park" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when families usually go to the park to play.
quests.explanation: Yes! Flying a kite is an outdoor activity, best done when it's light and breezy.
quests.funFact: The very first kites were invented in China over 2,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Watching the sky slowly turn dark"?
quests.hint: Think about what happens to the sky's color once the sun goes down.
quests.explanation: Yes! The sky turns dark after the sun sets.
quests.funFact: The sky turns dark because our side of the Earth slowly turns away from the sun!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "A rooster crowing on the farm". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about the farm animal known for waking everyone up.
quests.explanation: Yes! Roosters famously crow early in the morning as the sun comes up.
quests.funFact: A rooster's crow can be heard from almost two miles away!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "A bat flapping silently through the air". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about the flying animal that comes out once it's dark.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bats are nocturnal and fly around searching for food at night.
quests.funFact: Bats use a special hearing trick called echolocation to fly safely in the dark!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Building a sandcastle at the beach"?
quests.hint: Think about when families usually visit the beach to play.
quests.explanation: Yes! Building sandcastles is a sunny, outdoor beach activity.
quests.funFact: The best sand for building castles is a little bit wet, not dry!

quests.instruction: "Dreaming a happy dream" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the fun, make-believe stories your brain creates while you sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We dream while we're sleeping at night.
quests.funFact: Almost everyone dreams every single night, even if they don't remember it!
